name: Tide between Countries
source:
Two people get stuck on an island on the border between their countries. And there's sharks around them. And some other creature on the island too.

[From [url=https://sealiteral.itch.io/tide-between-countries]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
两个人被困在两国边境的一座岛上。他们周围有鲨鱼。还有岛上的其他一些生物。

[来自[url=https://sealiteral.itch.io/tide-between-countries]itch.io[/url]]
